subject: Interview With Actress Eliza Barmakian
overview: Host Steve Bertorelli interviewed actress Eliza Barmakian regarding her lead role in the play Wait Until Dark and her experiences as a low-vision performer. Barmakian discussed her eye condition, her background in musical theater, and her upcoming projects in Cambridge.

items.title: Introduction of Eliza Barmakian
items.summary: Host Steve Bertorelli introduced guest Eliza Barmakian and discussed seeing her perform in the play Wait Until Dark at the Greater Boston Stage Company.

items.title: Discussion of Aniridia and Low Vision
items.summary: Barmakian explained her eye condition, aniridia, and how she navigates the world and the stage with reduced vision and light sensitivity.

items.title: Childhood Interest in Theater
items.summary: Barmakian recounted how her childhood mobility challenges led her to find connection and imagination through music and storytelling.

items.title: Casting and Representation in Theater
items.summary: The guest discussed the casting process for visually impaired actors and praised director Waylon Symes for casting her in a lead role.

items.title: WBZ News Report on Wait Until Dark
items.summary: The program aired a news segment featuring Barmakian, co-actor Jenny S. Lee, and director Waylon Symes discussing the unique staging of their production.

items.title: Stage Navigation and Performance Prep
items.summary: Barmakian described her process for mapping out stage environments and set pieces during rehearsals to move confidently during performances.

items.title: Performance Demo Reel
items.summary: A video montage showcased Barmakian performing songs from various musical theater productions.

items.title: Future Projects and Closing
items.summary: Barmakian announced her upcoming appearance in the play One Name at the Foundry in Cambridge and provided her social media information.
